import_provenance.original_title: Classifying sets with countable infinite-time decision complexity
import_provenance.original_statement: Characterize, in terms of the constructible hierarchy, the sets of reals decidable by an infinite-time Turing machine with a countable uniform bound on its halting times, and the corresponding semidecidable classes. The known suprema of possible times do not characterize which sets have such algorithms.
